text: Government is shutting down all digital payments and UPI starting midnight.
Salt and sugar shortage announced across Gujarat, stock up immediately.
Viruses spreading through 5G mobile towers causing sickness in local towns.
Curfew declared across all districts in Gujarat due to communal tension.
દ્વારકા અને અમદાવાદ વચ્ચે તમામ ટ્રેનો રદ કરવામાં આવી છે.
